vignette: A 48-year-old woman has had brief nocturnal attacks for years: she sits up suddenly, her right arm rises abducted and her head turns toward it, she makes a loud noise, and it is over in twenty seconds. She remembers the attacks. Two EEGs have been normal and she was told the attacks are psychological.
explanation: A brief nocturnal tonic seizure with a fencing posture (contralateral arm abducted, head turned toward it), vocalization and preserved awareness is the signature of the supplementary motor area; the focus is interhemispheric, so the scalp EEG is often normal, and the posture points to the left SMA. Medial temporal seizures begin with an epigastric aura and impair awareness.
